field.label: Log type
field.help: Where query logs are written. Disabled turns logging off; Console writes to the Blocky log; Text/CSV write files to the target directory; the database options write to an external DB using the connection string in Target.

field.label: Target
field.help: Directory for file logging (e.g. /var/log/blocky), or the database connection string for the database options. Not used for Console.

field.label: Retention (days)
field.help: Delete query logs older than this many days. 0 keeps them indefinitely.

field.label: Logged fields
field.help: Which fields to record per query. Leave empty to log all fields.

field.label: Flush interval
field.help: How often buffered entries are written to the target.

field.label: Creation attempts
field.help: Number of attempts to open the log target (file or database) before giving up.

field.label: Creation cooldown
field.help: Wait time between attempts to open the log target.
